"""Replayable regular-script 鳳: fourteen lengthwise, pressure-varying brush strokes."""
import numpy as np, json, time, argparse
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.interpolate import CubicSpline,PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
D=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PX=.00022185986964255727

def root_samples(p, speed=.010):
 p=np.array(p,float)
 if p[-1,2]>0:
  p=np.vstack([p,[*p[-1,:2],0]])
 t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1),1))]
 n=int(np.ceil(t[-1]*PX/speed/.05))
 ts=np.linspace(0,t[-1],n+1)
 xy=np.column_stack([CubicSpline(t,p[:,j],bc_type='natural')(ts) for j in range(2)])
 v=np.column_stack([CubicSpline(t,p[:,j],bc_type='natural')(ts,1) for j in range(2)]);v/=np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1)[:,None]
 w=np.maximum(0,PchipInterpolator(t,p[:,2])(ts))
 depth=(w*PX+.0003)/1.187
 # Gather to a point at the two ends, and lift without dragging a broad tuft.
 depth[0]=0;depth[-1]=0
 zcm=depth*100
 offset=np.maximum(0,(-.967*zcm*zcm+2.109994*zcm-.036001727)/100)
 tip=xy+offset[:,None]/PX*v
 world=np.column_stack([.01359225325698932-(tip[:,1]+.5)*PX,.11359225325698932-(tip[:,0]+.5)*PX,.020-depth])
 return world,xy,w

def main():
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--paths',default=str(D/'fit.npz'));parser.add_argument('--name',default='trajectory');parser.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.010);parser.add_argument('--lead',type=float,default=.09);parser.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');a=parser.parse_args()
 z=np.load(a.paths);paths=[z[f'p{i}'] for i in range(14)]
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json');p=s.primitives();s.record_start();start=time.time()
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.07],speed=.12,settle=3);p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.024],speed=.03,settle=5);p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.05,settle=3)
 for i,path in enumerate(paths):
  world,xy,w=root_samples(path,a.speed)
  # Approach in the initial writing direction to orient the hairs.
  dv=world[1,:2]-world[0,:2];dv/=np.linalg.norm(dv)
  pre=world[0].copy();pre[:2]-=dv*.004;pre[2]=.04
  p['move_tip'](pre,speed=.12,settle=2)
  pre2=world[0].copy();pre2[2]=.022
  p['move_tip'](pre2,speed=.025,settle=3)
  # A velocity lead compensates the Panda's damped position controller.
  vel=np.gradient(world,.05,axis=0)
  commands=world+a.lead*vel
  for j,cmd in enumerate(commands):
   q,ok,err=s.ik(cmd)
   if not ok:print('IK error',i,j,err,flush=True)
   s.step(q)
  end=world[-1].copy();end[2]=.030
  p['move_tip'](end,speed=.02,settle=3)
  print('stroke',i+1,'steps',s.n_steps,'seconds',round(time.time()-start,1),flush=True)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,0,.08],speed=.1,settle=8)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,D/(a.name+'.npz'))
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(D/(a.name+'.png'))
 np.savez_compressed(D/(a.name+'_strokes.npz'),**{f's{i}':r['samples'] for i,r in enumerate(s.strokes()) if r['sheet']=='main'})
 print('state_sha',s.state_sha(),flush=True)
 if a.score:
  score=s.score();print(json.dumps(score,indent=2),flush=True);(D/(a.name+'_score.json')).write_text(json.dumps(score,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
